traditional: 以 A 為母語嘅人
jyutping: ji5 A wai6 mou5 jyu5 ge3 jan4

english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken construction when you want to say that someone grew up speaking A as their mother tongue.

examples.english: My cousin is a native speaker of English, and she also speaks Cantonese fluently.
examples.traditional: 我表姐係以英文為母語嘅人，廣東話都講得好流利。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 biu2 ze1 hai6 ji5 jing1 man2 wai6 mou5 jyu5 ge3 jan4 gwong2 dung1 waa2 dou1 gong2 dak1 hou2 lau4 lei6
